title: Sim Lim Square Will Be Managed by Ohmyhome Property Management Starting 1 August 2026
summary: Ohmyhome Property Management officially took over as Sim Lim Square’s managing agent on 1 August 2026. Learn what this means for the mall.
body_markdown:
Last Updated on August 6, 2026 byYolly Del Prado


[Ohmyhome Property Management (OPM)](https://pm.ohmyhome.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=clickthru&utm_campaign=OPMManageSimLimSquare) , the property management arm of[Ohmyhome](https://ohmyhome.com/en-sg/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=clickthru&utm_campaign=OPMManageSimLimSquare) , officially took over as Sim Lim Square’s managing agent on 1 August 2026, further expanding its established portfolio of more than 10,000 managed units across strata-titled developments, malls and other establishments islandwide.


Appointed by the mall’s Management Corporation Strata Title (MCST), OPM now oversees the property operations of the prominent commercial development while working closely with the council and other stakeholders.


## Managing a Familiar Singapore Landmark


Located at 1 Rochor Canal Road, Sim Lim Square has been part of Singapore’s retail landscape since 1987. For many Singaporeans, it is the place that comes to mind when they need a new computer, camera, phone, audio equipment or hard-to-find electronic components.


Behind this familiar shopping destination is a sizeable strata-titled commercial development. Sim Lim Square comprises 492 commercial units across six above-ground storeys and two basement levels, bringing together unit owners, retailers, service providers, employees and visitors under one roof.


With so much activity taking place across the property, consistent coordination is essential. Facilities must be maintained, vendors and security teams must work together, and financial and compliance matters must be properly recorded and followed up on.


## What OPM Oversees at Sim Lim Square


As managing agent, OPM coordinates the key areas that support Sim Lim Square’s daily property operations. Its responsibilities include:


- Facilities and maintenance
- Vendor and security coordination
- Financial administration
- Regulatory compliance
- Communication with the council and other stakeholders


When a maintenance issue is raised, for example, OPM coordinates the assessment, required approvals, vendor arrangements, scheduling and follow-up. For financial and compliance matters, the team maintains organised records and provides the council with the information needed to track matters requiring attention.


By coordinating these areas, OPM helps the council maintain oversight of the property while ensuring that each matter moves through the appropriate process.


## Supporting Coordination Through Simple App


Simple App, OPM’s proprietary digital estate management platform, helps the estate management team and council coordinate property matters at Sim Lim Square.


Through the platform, both sides can track maintenance requests and manage financial reporting, vendor approvals and compliance records in one place. This gives them a shared view of what has been raised, what is being handled and what still requires action.


For a commercial property with hundreds of units, centralising this information makes everyday coordination easier. Instead of tracing updates across separate conversations and records, the team and council can refer to the same platform as each matter progresses.


Simple App complements the work carried out by OPM’s estate management team. While the platform keeps requests, records and approvals organised, the team continues to coordinate with vendors, follow up on outstanding matters and keep the council informed.


## Bringing Relevant Experience to Sim Lim Square


OPM’s work at Sim Lim Square draws on its experience across[a wider portfolio of residential, commercial and mixed-use developments](https://ohmyhome.com/en-sg/blog/ohmyhome-property-management-advances-next-phase-of-growth-with-focus-on-larger-residential-and-commercial-properties/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=clickthru&utm_campaign=OPMManageSimLimSquare) . Examples include Parc Vista and Parkview Apartments in the residential sector, King Albert Park Mall in the commercial sector, and Affinity at Serangoon and eCO as mixed-use developments.


Just as OPM oversees facilities, vendors, financial administration, compliance and stakeholder communication across its existing portfolio, it manages these same core areas at Sim Lim Square. However, no two developments operate in exactly the same way. OPM therefore works closely with Sim Lim Square’s council to align its management approach with the mall’s operational priorities, commercial environment and stakeholder needs.

## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does switching to OPM as the estate manager affect existing tenant leases at Sim Lim Square?**


No, a change in estate management doesn’t affect existing lease agreements, since those are separate contracts between tenants and the mall’s landlord or owner. OPM’s role covers day-to-day operations like maintenance and upkeep, not the terms tenants signed on.


### What’s the difference between a managing agent like OPM and a management council or MCST at a property like Sim Lim Square?


A managing agent like OPM handles the day-to-day operations on behalf of the management council, while a management council or MCST is the governing body that oversees and makes decisions on behalf of owners. OPM works under the direction of Sim Lim Square’s management council, running maintenance and tenant requests, while major decisions still sit with the council itself.


### Is Ohmyhome Property Management (OPM) a separate company from Ohmyhome, or part of the same business?


OPM is Ohmyhome’s property management arm, not a separate company, operating as the team handling estate operations under the wider Ohmyhome business. This means Sim Lim Square’s management ties back to the same company known for property agency services, just working through its dedicated property management division.
